page_title: MET 2-0 LEN | Metz v Lens 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Metz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+2' A second caution from Abdelatif Kherradji for Gauthier Hein (Metz) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
90+2' 2 - 0 Gauthier Hein (Metz) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' A substitution has been made. Florian Thauvin goes off and Rayan Fofana (Lens) comes on.
88' It is time for a substitution. Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) is on for Jonathan Gradit.
88' 1 - 0 Goal! Gauthier Hein (Metz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Robin Risser into the top right corner.
86' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' One of the Lens players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Metz.
84' The possession of the ball – 47:53.
83' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Metz.
82' Here is a change. Jessy Deminguet is going off and Stephane Le Mignan gives the last tactical orders to Ismael Guerti (Metz).
81' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Cheikh Sabaly is replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Georgiy Tsitaishvili leaves the pitch and Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) comes on.
79' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:3.
76' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
72' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
68' Gauthier Hein (Metz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
64' Gauthier Hein (Metz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul.
63' That's the end of the game for Deiver Machado, who is replaced by Ruben Aguilar (Lens).
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:6.
59' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

57' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Robin Risser thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

57' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Metz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
56' Metz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
52' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

51' Habib Diallo (Metz) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Risser is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Metz can continue in their attacking effort.
50' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Pierre Sage gives a chance to Wesley Said (Lens) and Odsonne Edouard is off.
46' Pierre Sage has made a change at the break. Morgan Guilavogui has come on in place of Abdallah Sima (Lens).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Deiver Machado (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Abdelatif Kherradji and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+3' Abdallah Sima (Lens) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+2' Great teamplay by Metz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
45+1' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Lens are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.

43' Koffi Kouao (Metz) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away.
43' The Metz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
38' A rebound spins to Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
37' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Habib Diallo (Metz) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
35' Metz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
33' A lofted cross from Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' Robin Risser is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz). Easy save!
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.

27' The Lens players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
23' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
17' Metz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Alpha Toure (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji had an easy-decision to make.
12' Wonderful movement by Lens. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
10' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Jonathan Fischer, who pulls off a stunning save!
5' Lens are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The Metz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
Metz will kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
